content.short: ASYM is an agentic AI system that ideates, codes and executes trading strategies.
content.description: ASYM runs an agent pipeline that generates trading ideas, writes the code to implement them and then executes, rather than automating a strategy a human specified. Letting the agent choose the strategy as well as run it is a meaningful step further than most trading bots take, and the backtest discipline matters correspondingly more.
content.meta: An agent pipeline that writes, codes and runs its own trading strategies rather than automating yours.
